ana_serrano_7: The new rifleman is Isidor Serrano, once a tram conductor from Old Harrow. The corporal asked if a tram conductor was any use in a trench. Isidor Serrano said he would find out.
Number 56 on the early rolls: Isidor Serrano. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F14, Isidor Serrano listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Isidor Serrano found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Isidor Serrano dreamt he was back in Old Harrow, working as a tram conductor. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Isidor Serrano's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
romanbhassell: The sergeant gave Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 3 or any other.

Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Jonas Solyommadar crossed it, Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel fired. Jonas Solyommadar was grazed. Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel transferred to the sappers. The men in R-F6 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

A direct hit on the trench at R-F6. Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel was the only one they could still help, and only just. Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel was killed outright by a direct hit at R-F6. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.
The House of Romanbhassel sent another. Anselm Romanbhassel, brother of Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

Anselm Romanbhassel polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. A letter from home reached Anselm Romanbhassel before dusk. Anselm Romanbhassel read it twice and slept a little easier.
